reason: Key A (Valid) wrong: 'some students are scholars' does not make all scholars students; also replaced True/False options.

fields.text: All students study. Some students are scholars. Conclusion: All scholars study. The conclusion is:
fields.optionB: Invalid, because some scholars may not be students
fields.optionC: Invalid, because some students may not study
fields.optionD: Valid, because students and scholars are the same group
fields.explanation: Only some students are known to be scholars; scholars who are not students are not covered by 'all students study', so the conclusion does not follow.
fields.steps:
1. All students study.
2. Some students are scholars: only part of the scholars group is known to be students.
3. Scholars outside the students group are not covered by premise 1.
4. 'All scholars study' does not follow: invalid.
fields.hint: Is every scholar known to be a student?
fields.whyA: The premises only say some students are scholars, not that every scholar is a student.
fields.whyC: This contradicts the premise 'All students study.'
fields.whyD: 'Some students are scholars' does not make the two groups identical.
fields.explanationTl: Ilan lang sa students ang scholars. 'Yung scholars na hindi students, hindi sakop ng 'all students study', kaya invalid ang conclusion.
fields.stepsTl:
1. Lahat ng students ay nag-aaral.
2. Ilan sa students ay scholars.
3. 'Yung scholars na hindi students, hindi sakop ng premise 1.
4. Hindi sigurado na lahat ng scholars ay nag-aaral: invalid.
fields.hintTl: Sigurado ba na lahat ng scholars ay students?

fields.text: The statement "All the applicants passed the exam" is false. Which must be true?
fields.optionB: At least one applicant did not pass the exam.
fields.optionD: Exactly one applicant failed the exam.
fields.explanation: To make 'all passed' false, it is enough for at least one applicant not to pass; nothing more is guaranteed.
fields.steps:
1. 'All passed' is false.
2. So not every applicant passed.
3. At least one applicant did not pass.
4. How many others passed or failed is unknown.
fields.hint: What is the smallest thing that would make 'all passed' false?
fields.whyA: 'All passed' is also false when some passed and some failed, so no-one-passed is not required.
fields.whyC: It is possible that nobody passed, so this need not be true.
fields.whyD: More than one applicant could have failed.
fields.explanationTl: Para maging false ang 'all passed', sapat na may isang hindi pumasa. 'Yan lang ang sigurado.
fields.stepsTl:
1. False ang 'all passed'.
2. Kaya hindi lahat pumasa.
3. May at least isang hindi pumasa.
4. Hindi alam kung ilan pa ang pumasa o bumagsak.
fields.hintTl: Ano ang pinakamaliit na kailangan para maging false ang 'all passed'?
